dim_date.description: Conformed calendar. Grain: one row per date. date_key is a DATE.

dim_ingredient.description: Ingredient dimension with purchase unit and unit cost. Grain: one row per ingredient.

dim_location.description: Cafe location dimension. Grain: one row per location.

dim_product.description: Product dimension. Grain: one row per product.

dim_waste_reason.description: Waste reason dimension. Holds the avoidability policy and the prevention lever. Grain: one row per waste reason.

fct_demand_events.description: External demand event fact. Grain: one row per event (event_id). Attendance is an estimate, so the row carries a confidence class and a signal weight.

fct_inventory_snapshot.description: Inventory snapshot fact. Grain: location + snapshot_date + ingredient. A snapshot is a state, not a movement: summing it across days is invalid.

fct_sales.description: Sales fact. Grain: one row per sale line (sale_id). Measures: units_sold, demand_qty. Never aggregate this table directly; use the marts.

fct_waste_events.description: Waste fact. Grain: one row per waste event (waste_id). Measures: waste_quantity, estimated_cost. Reference coverage flags stay visible so orphaned rows cannot silently drop out of reporting.

int_sales_ingredient_demand.description: Ingredient demand by day, location and ingredient. This is the denominator for waste rates. Grain: sale_date + location_id + ingredient_id.

int_waste_with_context.description: Waste enriched with denominators, cost and avoidability. Grain: one row per waste event. Every join uses the full business key, so the model cannot fan out.

mart_demand_events.description: Event impact on local demand and waste. Grain: event_id + location_id. Forward looking events carry a signal but no measured lift.

mart_dq_expectations.description: Declared data quality expectations, versioned with the models they protect. The trust engine evaluates these after every build.

mart_food_loss_summary.description: Estate level food loss summary. Grain: location_id, plus one 'all' row for the estate total. Publishes the ratio of totals for the waste rate, never an average of per-row ratios.

mart_metric_registry.description: Registry of every published metric: definition, source model, measurement type and the trust states in which it may be displayed.

mart_purchase_plan.description: Purchase planning aid. Grain: location_id + ingredient_id. Recommendations are explainable heuristics, not forecasts.

mart_waste_by_category.description: Waste by ingredient category. Grain: category.

mart_waste_by_ingredient.description: Waste by ingredient and location. Grain: ingredient_id + location_id.

mart_waste_daily.description: Waste trend series. Grain: waste_date + location_id.

mart_waste_opportunity.description: Waste opportunity table. Grain: waste_date + location_id + ingredient_id + waste_reason. Carries coverage ratios so consumers know how much of the row is backed by a denominator.

mart_waste_priority.description: Ranked prevention backlog. Grain: waste_date + location_id + ingredient_id + waste_reason. Ranked by cost x avoidability x coverage, with a per-row trust state.

stg_events.description: External demand events. Grain: one row per event.

stg_ingredients.description: Ingredient master. Grain: one row per ingredient.

stg_inventory_snapshots.description: End-of-day stock on hand. Grain: location + date + ingredient.

stg_locations.description: Location master. Grain: one row per cafe.

stg_products.description: Product master. Grain: one row per product.

stg_sales.description: Point-of-sale unit counts. Grain: one row per sale line.

stg_waste_events.description: Recorded waste. Grain: one row per waste event.
